accounts.name: Novartis
accounts.footprint_summary: Italian manufacturing at Torre Annunziata (Naples; FDA-certified since 2021, >100M packs/yr) and Ivrea; HQ in Origgio (Varese). The €350M 2023-2025 Italy plan started with Torre Annunziata and Ivrea.
accounts.investment_strategy_summary: Capacity and innovation space at Torre Annunziata: a €32M expansion approved by the Campania ZES commissioner (reported March 2026), after a >€30M line opened in Feb 2024.
accounts.priority_reason: Dated, approved brownfield expansion in the window with a 'new technologies' / life-science innovation scope. Amount is small and no digital scope is stated, so held as an entry-level Tier 1 lead; Ivrea not yet researched.

accounts.name: Sanofi
accounts.footprint_summary: Anagni (biotech, vaccines, enzyme replacement; sterile freeze-dried line), Scoppito (L'Aquila; oral solids, ~€50M 2020-22 + €7.3M in 2024) and Origgio.
accounts.investment_strategy_summary: Anagni: Invitalia development contract of €47.3M (€17.4M grant) for a new sterile freeze-dried line; plus a 2022 MISE innovation agreement (~€27M, €6.3M grant) for prototype freeze-drying systems. No 2026 announcement found.
accounts.priority_reason: Sterile lyophilisation and biotech at Anagni is a strong GMP-automation profile, but the projects found pre-date the window and no new 2026-27 programme was found. Monitor until a dated project appears.

accounts.name: GSK
accounts.footprint_summary: Verona (respiratory/oral) and San Polo di Torrile, Parma (ViiV HIV, oncology, autoimmune; supplies >100 markets).
accounts.investment_strategy_summary: A secondary source reports ~€215M across GSK's Italian sites in 2025-2027, mainly technology upgrades, sustainability and plant modernisation. The split by site is not disclosed.
accounts.priority_reason: A modernisation programme is exactly the Orise trigger, but it is Italy-wide, from a secondary source, with no site split. Needs the GSK press release to qualify.

accounts.name: Eli Lilly
accounts.footprint_summary: Sesto Fiorentino (Florence): biotech/insulin and, per the new lot, diabetes and obesity medicines; Italy hub.
accounts.investment_strategy_summary: Over €750M announced for a new production lot at Sesto Fiorentino for diabetes/obesity drugs, with a 2025 horizon; the Lilly Italy president said investments would be fully finalised by end-2025 (Il Sole 24 Ore, 2025).
accounts.priority_reason: Very large, but the build was due to finish by end-2025, so the window is commissioning and lifecycle rather than a new build. No new 2026 investment announced (Sept 2026 coverage is the 150th anniversary).

accounts.name: Menarini
accounts.footprint_summary: Italian plants at Florence (2), Pisa (2), Pomezia, L'Aquila, Lomagna (Lecco) and Casaletto Lodigiano (Lodi). 2025 revenue €4.887B.
accounts.investment_strategy_summary: March 2026: approved restructuring of the Florence vial area with a new aseptic line, €14-15M (Lucia Aleotti, results press event). Separate, older €150M Sesto Fiorentino plant coverage (date not verified).
accounts.priority_reason: A new aseptic line is a clear, dated, in-window brownfield project with CSV, SCADA and MES implications. Amount is modest; L'Aquila and Pisa not yet researched.

accounts.name: Chiesi
accounts.footprint_summary: Parma (HQ, manufacturing, Biotech Center of Excellence) and, from 2025, Nerviano (Milan), the former Carlo Erba/Farmitalia research site.
accounts.investment_strategy_summary: €430M at Nerviano over 2025-2030 to convert a 124,000 m² site into a production hub for low-carbon-footprint inhalers and sterile biologics, ~300 jobs by 2029; first activity from 2026, full operation 2030. Linked investments planned at Parma and Blois (France).
accounts.priority_reason: Largest dated, in-window project found: a multi-year conversion into a regulated manufacturing site, so automation, MES and validation decisions fall in 2026-2029. Highest priority of this batch.

sites.site_name: Chiesi Nerviano production hub (former Carlo Erba site)
sites.technical_scope: Redevelopment of a 124,000 m² industrial area, the former Farmitalia Carlo Erba oncology research centre (founded 1965, closed 2024), into a manufacturing site focused on low-carbon-footprint inhalers, with sterile biological products. Includes a photovoltaic park; tied to Chiesi's Net Zero 2035 goal. About 300 jobs by 2029.

orise_fit.reason: New regulated manufacturing site that must be built out and commissioned over 2026-2029. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
New inhaler and sterile biologics production needs batch execution and release flow. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
GMP site start-up with sterile biologics brings Annex 11 / data integrity validation. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Greenfield-like conversion allows a connected-plant design from the start. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.

sites.notes: Announced March 2025, before the Jan 2026 window, but activity runs through the window. Classed BROWNFIELD because it converts an existing site; functionally a new manufacturing build, so treat as greenfield-equivalent for Orise. No digital or automation statement found.

sites.site_name: Novartis Torre Annunziata expansion (life-science innovation space)
modality: finished dosage / packaging (not specified in sources)
sites.expected_start: Not found in public sources (approval reported March 2026)
sites.technical_scope: Expansion of the Torre Annunziata site with a space for development, innovation and new technologies in life sciences, to raise production capacity. Plan approved by the Campania ZES commissioner, Giuseppe Romano. The site was FDA-certified in 2021 and passed 100M packs/yr.

orise_fit.reason: 'New technologies' innovation space and capacity growth at an FDA-audited site. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Capacity growth on existing packaging/production lines. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
FDA-certified site, so changes need validated systems. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.

sites.notes: Approval date could not be confirmed on a second search; one source cites a different, larger plan (€80M, 300 hires) which seems to be an older, separate plan and is not recorded. Earlier: >€30M line opened Feb 2024 and €350M Italy plan 2023-2025 (not in window).

sites.site_name: Menarini Florence vial area restructuring and new aseptic line
sites.expected_start: Not found in public sources (approved; stated March 2026)
sites.technical_scope: Restructuring of the vial department at the Florence plant with a new aseptic line, approved and announced by Lucia Aleotti at the 2025 results press event (March 2026).

orise_fit.reason: A new aseptic line needs qualification and computerised-system validation (Annex 1 / Annex 11). Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
New line control and integration with the existing plant. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Vial area batch records and line integration. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.

sites.notes: The €14-15M figure comes from a search summary of a Fortune Italia piece whose URL implies 2023; the Sky/LaPresse March 2026 pieces cover the same results event. Verify the exact quote.

sites.site_name: Lilly Sesto Fiorentino new production lot (diabetes and obesity)
sites.expected_start: Horizon 2025; 'fully finalised by end of 2025' per Il Sole 24 Ore (2025). Current status not found
sites.technical_scope: New lot at the Sesto Fiorentino plant (operating since 1959-62) to expand production of drugs for diabetes and obesity. Estimated contribution of €1.5B to Italian GDP and >6,000 jobs in the supply chain (Forbes Italia, Nov 2024).

orise_fit.reason: Commissioning and ramp-up of a large new lot, then long-term support. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Ramp-up and validation of new biologics lines. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Scale of the new lot suggests data and OT integration needs. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.

sites.notes: Sources disagree on whether the plan was announced in 2023 or 2024. Not found: whether the lot is complete, and any 2026 follow-on investment (Sept 2026 coverage is the 150th anniversary).

sites.site_name: Sanofi Anagni sterile freeze-dried line and lyophilisation prototype systems
sites.investment_display: €47.3 million (Invitalia contract, €17.4M grant); separate ~€27M MISE agreement
sites.expected_start: Not found in public sources (pre-2026 projects)
sites.technical_scope: New line for sterile freeze-dried products under an Invitalia development contract, plus a 2022 MISE innovation agreement (~€27M, €6.3M grant) for prototype freeze-drying production systems.

orise_fit.reason: Pre-2026 line already built; support and lifecycle work follow. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Revalidation or change control on a sterile line. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.

sites.notes: Both projects pre-date the Jan 2026 window; shown as Monitor only. €37M+ investment over the last three years (Mimit, Regione Lazio) is also cited by Sanofi's site page. Scoppito (€7.3M in 2024) not recorded as a project.

sites.site_name: Chiesi Parma Biotech Center of Excellence
sites.investment_display: €85 million (one source: ~€400M for the whole Parma biotech hub; not reconciled)
sites.expected_start: Was due to be operational from 2024
sites.technical_scope: Biotech centre inside the existing Parma site for development and production of active ingredients such as monoclonal antibodies, enzymes and other proteins.

orise_fit.reason: If now operational, lifecycle and expansion support. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Biologics GMP site changes. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.

sites.notes: Pre-window project; the €85M and ~€400M figures conflict. Chiesi also plans related investment at Parma as part of the Nerviano strategy (no amount found).

sites.investment_display: ~€215 million across GSK Italy 2025-2027 (not site-specific; not counted in totals)
sites.technical_scope: Reported plan to invest about €215M across GSK's Italian sites in 2025-2027, mainly for technology upgrades, environmental sustainability and plant modernisation. Pin placed at San Polo di Torrile as the main GSK plant; the split between Verona and Torrile is not disclosed.

orise_fit.reason: A technology-upgrade programme often includes legacy control and MES refresh. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Modernisation across plants is a digital trigger. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.
Upgrades need revalidation. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.

sites.notes: Secondary source only; another source cites €324M across Italian sites. Needs the GSK Italy press release. Torrile's last confirmed project is the 2018 ViiV HIV plant (€30M).

sites.technical_scope: New plant of about 40,000 m² near Florence with capacity of roughly 100 million packs a year, as reported in older press. Date and current status not verified.

orise_fit.reason: If operational, lifecycle support. Assessed from project scope; no public statement about automation or digital scope was found.

gaps_html:
Status of the Italy research

First batch only: Novartis, Sanofi, GSK, Eli Lilly, Menarini and Chiesi. Remaining Tier 1 (Roche, Merck KGaA, MSD, Pfizer, AbbVie, BMS, Bayer, Takeda, Amgen, AstraZeneca, J&J/Janssen, Novo Nordisk) and Tier 2 (Angelini, Recordati, Italfarmaco, Zambon, Dompé, Alfasigma, Bracco, Kedrion, Catalent, Thermo Fisher/Patheon, BSP, CordenPharma, Olon, IBSA, Fareva) are not researched yet.

How reliable the figures are

  • Amounts and dates come from search-result summaries of the cited pages. The pages themselves could not be opened in this environment, so each figure needs a quick manual check against the linked source before it is quoted to a customer.
  • Only Chiesi Nerviano is confirmed by several independent outlets (High). Others are Medium or Low; the reason is in each record's notes.
  • No site shows a public statement about MES, CSV or Industry 4.0 scope. The Orise fit ratings are assessed from project scope and are labelled that way.

Not yet searched

  • Permitting signals: VIA/VAS, AIA, SUAP and regional BUR notices; Invitalia and regional agency listings.
  • Trade press: NCF, AboutPharma, Pharmaceutical Technology Europe, BioProcess International; ISPE Italy and AFI.
  • Sanofi Scoppito, Novartis Ivrea and Origgio, Menarini L'Aquila and Pisa, Verona (GSK).

For you to fill

  • Paywalled and login sources (Industrial Info, IIR, LinkedIn) were not used. Contacts by role (site director, engineering/capital projects, automation or IT-OT lead, procurement) need your LinkedIn network.
  • Incumbent vendors per site (PAS-X, AVEVA PI, SCADA) are not public; internal knowledge needed.
  • EUR amounts are shown in USD at 1 USD = 0.86 EUR on the dashboard.
